blockers.reason: Charter and exit artifacts are unsigned by the responsible owner.
No real beta cohort, measured SLOs or live security-update channel; P35 dependency also unresolved.
No real-device playback quality or call-protection verification; no WebRTC call path.
Physical iPhone, iPad and Android runs are missing; only simulators/emulators were exercised.
Sync payloads are TLS-only and not end-to-end encrypted.
Official WPT suite was not run; only a WPT-style corpus exists.
Download quarantine, resume and integrity checks are screens only.
Remote CI has not been observed green for the current tree.
